units.locator: Article 9.24. Violation of heat-supply legislation
units.text: 1. Failure by an authorised official of a local self-government body of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, or of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or by an authorised official of an executive body of a city of federal significance, to send, within the time limit established by heat-supply legislation, a draft heat-supply scheme or a draft updated heat-supply scheme for such a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or a city of federal significance, to the federal executive body authorised to implement state policy on heat supply for approval —
